contea di ritrovamento: Norfolk (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [F P M TR P COS P P

An incomplete silver roman coin; a Denarius of Hadrian ( AD 117 TO AD 138), dating from AD 117 (Reece Period 6). [PARTHIC DIVI] TRAIAN AVG [F P M TR P COS P P reverse type depicting two figures; Trajan standing to the left delivering a globe to Hadrian standing to the right facing him. Both should be laureate and togate. Both are holding rolls in the left hand. Mint of Rome. Compare RIC II…
